abstract: Ultrasonography is a very useful diagnostic tool to evaluate pediatric abdominal mass. This cross sectional study was conducted among clinically suspected patients having malignant abdominal mass attending in the department of Radiology & Imaging, Mymensingh Medical College Hospital, Mymensingh, Bangladesh from January 2008 to December 2009. Total 56 patients were included in this study. Patients were scanned by high resolution gray scale ultrasonography of the abdominal masses. After surgical procedure, biopsy specimen were collected in a container containing 10% formalin and sent for histopathological examination. Mean age of the patients group was 5.91 years with a standard deviation of ±3.21 years. All patients were within 2 to 13 years age. Out of all patients, male were 33(58.9%) and 23(41.1%) were female. Male and female ratio was 1.4:1. Ultrasonographic diagnosis as Wilm's tumour were 27(48.2%), hepatoblastoma 8(14.3%), lymphoma 7(12.5%), neuroblastoma 6(10.7%), suspected malignancy 6(10.7%) and lastly teratoma were 2(3.6%). Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), negative predictive value (NPV) and accuracy of ultrasonography in the evaluation of Wilm's tumour were 100.0%, 90.6%, 88.9%, 100.0% and 94.6% for neuroblastoma 83.3%, 98.0%, 83.3%, 98.0% and 96.4% for lymphoma 83.3%, 96.0%, 71.4%, 98.0% and 94.6% and for hepatoblastoma 100.0%, 100.0%, 100.0%, 100.0% and 100.0% respectively. It is a noninvasive and cost effective modality. Carefully performed ultrasonographic study would give reliable and accurate information needed in the diagnosis of abdominal malignancy in children.
abstract_ja: 超音波検査は小児腹部腫瘤の評価に非常に有用な診断ツールである。本横断研究は、2008年1月から2009年12月までバングラデシュ・ミイメンシン医科大学病院の放射線科・画像診断部を受診し、臨床的に悪性腹部腫瘤が疑われた患者を対象に実施した。合計56例が本研究に組み入れられた。患者には高解像度グレースケール超音波検査を施行した。外科的処置後、生検標本を10%ホルマリンの入った容器に入れ、病理組織学的検査に提出した。患者群の平均年齢は5.91歳（標準偏差±3.21歳）であった。全患者は2歳から13歳の範囲であった。全患者のうち、男性は33例（58.9%）、女性は23例（41.1%）であり、男女比は1.4:1であった。超音波診断では、Wilms腫瘍27例(48.2%)、肝芽腫8例(14.3%)、リンパ腫7例(12.5%)、神経芽腫6例(10.7%)、悪性疑い6例(10.7%)、奇形腫2例(3.6%)であった。超音波検査によるWilms腫瘍の評価における感度、特異度、陽性的中率(PPV)、陰性的中率(NPV)、正確度はそれぞれ100.0%、90.6%、88.9%、100.0%、94.6%であった。神経芽腫では83.3%、98.0%、83.3%、98.0%、96.4%、リンパ腫では83.3%、96.0%、71.4%、98.0%、94.6%、肝芽腫では100.0%、100.0%、100.0%、100.0%、100.0%であった。超音波検査は非侵襲的かつ費用対効果の高い検査法である。注意深く行われた超音波検査は、小児の腹部悪性腫瘍の診断に必要な信頼できる正確な情報をもたらす。
